title: Marked Tape Reading
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $k$ be a natural number, and let the control state, input-head position, two families of $k$ work tapes with their head positions, and output word be arbitrary. Form a configuration with $2k$ work tapes by placing the first family before the second. For each $i<k$, the symbol read from tape $k+i$ is the content of the $i$th tape in the second family at its head position.
hypotheses_covered: natural number k and state type S
two k-tape contents Dt and Mt
two k-tape head-position families Dp and Mp
